locale.planet.pale-reach.name: The Pale Reach
locale.site.harmony-terrace.name: Site 52
locale.deposit.harmony-ferrite.name: Harmony Ferrite
locale.deposit.harmony-ferrite.description: Ferrite rubble on the terrace floor. The terrace was named before it was surveyed.
locale.deposit.lower-ferrite.name: Lower Ferrite
locale.deposit.lower-ferrite.description: A second ferrite field, downslope. Everything on this terrace is downslope of the terminal.
locale.deposit.white-veins.name: White Veins
locale.deposit.white-veins.description: Pale-veined ore at the foot of the terrace wall. It needs processing before it is good for anything.
locale.deposit.far-veins.name: Far Veins
locale.deposit.far-veins.description: The longest seam on the terrace, at the far end of it. The haul is the whole of the terrace.
locale.deposit.salt-cap.name: Salt Cap
locale.deposit.salt-cap.description: A small pale cap of catalytic stone. It was counted before anyone stood on it.
locale.deposit.under-vein.name: Under Vein
locale.deposit.under-vein.description: Veined ore under the terrace floor. The Extractor cannot reach it.
locale.deposit.cap-seam.name: Cap Seam
locale.deposit.cap-seam.description: Catalytic stone in a buried seam, directly beneath nothing in particular.
locale.deposit.glass-seam.name: Glass Seam
locale.deposit.glass-seam.description: A buried seam with a regular internal structure. The Institute has not said what it is.
